name: ssf-companion
description: A local-first PoE 1 SSF progression route companion
author: SSF Companion contributors

scripts.dev: pnpm install-electron && concurrently -k "vite --host 127.0.0.1" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 electron ."
scripts.test: vitest run && node scripts/check-http-cache-semantics.cjs && node scripts/check-sprintf-js-security.cjs && node scripts/check-release-workflow.cjs
scripts.package:win: pnpm install-electron && pnpm build && electron-builder --win portable --config.electronDist=node_modules/electron/dist
scripts.package:win:installer: pnpm install-electron && pnpm build && electron-builder --win nsis --config.electronDist=node_modules/electron/dist
